title: ageratina jalpanserra
intro: Ageratina jalpanserra, commonly known as Jalpa de Oro, is a plant species native to Mexico, belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina jalpanserra include its ability to calm the digestive system and reduce pain, while its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The health benefits of Ageratina jalpanserra are attributed to its ability to modulate various physiological processes, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
